title: Saint Lucian prime minister in Taiwan for state visit: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Saint Lucian Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre arrived in Taiwan on Tuesday morning for a five-day state visit, during which he will meet with President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) and other officials to discuss bilateral issues.

summary: Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) highlighted his administration's achievements and pledged to continue moving the capital forward at the opening of his campaign headquarters Monday, as he seeks a second term in the Nov. 28 local elections.

title: DPP's Shen unveils Taipei waterway plan, attends Halloween event
summary: Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋) on Monday proposed revitalizing the capital's waterways before attending a Halloween event where parents expressed support for his childcare policies.

title: Chiang, Shen speak out after entertainer's 'Taiwan independence' statement
summary: Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) and mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋) responded Monday after entertainer Kevin Tsai (蔡康永) issued a statement disavowing "Taiwan independence" amid suspected pressure from China.
